name: dojo
description: Anime-themed subagents: a strategist orchestrator plus backend, frontend, architecture, research, QA and docs crew, each with its own model, tools and voice. Includes optional visuals (themed spinners, crew band, toasts, transcript theme, banners, roster pane, mission report, gallery, rank, sounds) and guards (model, commit message, delegation budgets, compaction memory).

spinners.title: Themed spinners
spinners.description: Replace the spinner word with the on-duty strategist's (or a crew member's) verbs.

turnFlair.title: Turn-end flair
turnFlair.description: Past-tense themed word on the line that closes a turn (Outmaneuvered, Checkmated).

band.title: Crew band
band.description: Show one animated row per running dojo subagent above the prompt.

usageLine.title: Session usage line
usageLine.description: Show one row above the prompt with the session's context fill (Chakra) and the cost, plus the busiest rate-limit window (Stamina) once it passes 50%.

toasts.title: Deploy/return toasts
toasts.description: Short in-character toast when a dojo subagent is deployed, returns or falls, and when the crew rank goes up.

neutralMainTheme.title: Neutral strategist theme
neutralMainTheme.description: When no strategist persona is detected, still theme the main spinner with a neutral strategist pool.

commitGate.title: Commit gate
commitGate.description: Force the configured commit trailer into git texts and deny git commit commands whose inline message breaks the commit rules (Conventional Commits subject, no body, exact trailer). Applies in every session.

commitTrailer.title: Commit trailer
commitTrailer.description: The exact Co-Authored-By line commits must carry. Empty keeps Claude Code's own text and skips the trailer check.

roleGuard.title: Delegation budgets
roleGuard.description: In a dojo session, cap the main thread's inline edits and web lookups per turn and point it at dojo:senku, dojo:sanji, dojo:jiraiya or dojo:light.

architectGuard.title: Architect write guard
architectGuard.description: Keep dojo:kurisu's file writes out of the main working tree: Edit, Write and NotebookEdit are allowed only in the scratchpad, the system temp dir or an isolated worktree. Bash is not checked.

inlineEditFiles.title: Inline edit files per turn
inlineEditFiles.description: Distinct files the main thread may edit itself in one turn before it must delegate.

inlineEditLines.title: Inline edit lines
inlineEditLines.description: Largest Edit (lines in new_string) the main thread may make itself.

inlineLookups.title: Inline lookups per turn
inlineLookups.description: WebSearch and WebFetch calls the main thread may make itself in one turn before it must delegate.

archivist.title: Compaction memory
archivist.description: In a dojo session, tell the compaction summary to keep the on-duty line, the voice level, running dojo agents with their tasks, and the user's decisions.

transcriptTheme.title: Themed transcript
transcriptTheme.description: Frame messages, tool calls and subagent results in the on-duty character's colors: persona frames on messages, tool badges, crew cards and speech bubbles.

banners.title: Full crew cards
banners.description: Show full ASCII-banner crew cards in the transcript instead of one-line deploy/return lines.

promptChrome.title: Prompt chrome
promptChrome.description: Tag the session mode line under the prompt with the on-duty strategist's emoji and name, in its color.

rosterPane.title: Roster pane
rosterPane.description: Show the /dojo roster panel: the crew, who is on duty and who is running.

sounds.title: Sound cues
sounds.description: Play a sound cue when a dojo subagent is deployed, returns or fails.

paletteMode.title: Color palette
paletteMode.description: Colors of the dojo chrome and transcript. auto follows the Claude Code theme (light when its name contains "light"); dark and light force one.

rank.title: Crew rank
rank.description: Keep a rank that grows with every dojo crew member that returns, across sessions. Shown in /dojo and /dojo-recap, with a toast on rank-up.
